name: GUIDES
description: GUIDES evaluates whether an automatic evaluator tracks the executability of procedural text: whether a person following only the candidate could complete the intended task. It pairs each gold procedure with controlled perturbations in two domains, Smart-TV manuals (English and Brazilian Portuguese) and English cooking recipes, under 11 perturbation codes defined identically across both, separating genuine procedural errors from legitimate paraphrase. The release carries the annotation layer for both domains, the deterministic perturbation generators, the LLM-judge prompts, the per-pair metric and judge scores, and 600 human executability ratings from three raters over 200 pairs.
